create_ParamsDict: create a ParamsDict instance to store estimator parameters with non-default tracking and HTML representation
generate_html_params_table: generate an HTML table representation of scikit-learn estimator parameters with collapsible details and styled rows
build_doc_link_to_param: build a documentation link to a specific estimator parameter using text fragment anchors in the docstring
read_and_categorize_params: read and categorize estimator parameters as default or user-set with escaped, truncated values for safe display
scrape_estimator_docstring: scrape a scikit-learn estimator docstring into a structured NumpyDocString object with cached results
